what.text: This page follows refugees from Azerbaijan living in France, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 5015 Azerbaijani refugees in France, 3.8% of all refugees from Azerbaijan.
Armenia hosts the most Azerbaijani refugees, followed by Germany, France and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Artsakh (Nagorno-Karabakh) territory in Azerbaijan in periods from 1991 to 2023.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Azerbaijan in 1993 and 1995.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1996 at 5 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2012 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in France.
These are year-end totals for France only, reported to UNHCR.
